abstract: We employ a novel semiparametric Bayesian ordinal probit model to re-examine the relationships between age and life satisfaction (“happiness”) across countries and gender. Within our ordinal choice framework we introduce a new scheme for cutpoint simulation and develop a locally adaptive method for smoothing an otherwise erratic collection of age dummy variable coefficients. We find strong evidence that employment status is deeply intertwined with the reported happiness of men, that employment status is relatively more important for men than it is for women, and that the common use of quadratic models to report ages when happiness is minimized can produce inference that is inaccurate and misleadingly precise. We also find evidence that refines the “U”-shaped pattern between age and happiness that has been reported and/or debated in this literature: For men in most of the European countries we consider, happiness is found to rise sharply before traditional retirement age and then into the beginning of retirement, followed by a flattening or decline in the right-tail of the age distribution. Often-used models that are quadratic in age fail to reproduce this pattern and are frequently at odds with the data.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的半参数贝叶斯有序概率模型，重新审视了不同国家和性别间年龄与生活满意度（“幸福感”）之间的关系。在我们的有序选择框架内，引入了一种新的切点模拟方案，并开发了一种局部自适应方法来平滑原本不稳定的年龄虚拟变量系数序列。我们发现强有力的证据表明，就业状态与男性报告的幸福感紧密相关，且就业状态对男性的重要性相对高于女性；同时，常用二次模型来报告幸福感最低点年龄的做法，可能导致推断不准确且误导性地精确。我们还发现了细化该文献中已报道或争论的年龄与幸福感之间“U”形模式的证据：在我们考察的大多数欧洲国家中，男性的幸福感在传统退休年龄前急剧上升，并延续至退休初期，随后在年龄分布的右尾部分趋于平缓或下降。常用的年龄二次模型无法重现这一模式，且常常与数据不符。
title: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation in an ordinal probit model with application to life satisfaction across countries, age and gender
title_zh: 有序Probit模型的半参数贝叶斯估计及其在跨国、年龄与性别生活满意度中的应用
